plan.summary: Flow execution logging system with node-by-node trace JSONB storage, fire-and-forget integration in Automation orchestrator, API endpoints, and a FlowLogPanel UI in the flow editor. Also fixes 'Flow Tetiklendi' bug where message story showed flow trigger info regardless of WhatsApp line (instance_id). Note: message sending changed from streaming (fire-and-forget per message during execution) to sequential post-execution to support accurate pathSnapshotCount for trace logging.
plan.q_intent: her flow icin log tut ve UI da gostermek icin edit modundayken yukari dugme ekle. dikey kolon olarak acilsin. baska hattan gelen mesajlar icin flow tetiklendi yaziyor?
plan.interview_notes: Canvas highlight yok, sadece panel ici gosterim. Log paneli AI Chat ile mutual exclusion.

files_changed.change: New DB schema for flow_execution_log table
2 GET endpoints for execution log list/detail
Bug fix: instance-aware flow lookup in GetMessageStoryAsync
2 proxy routes for execution log endpoints
Zustand store for flow log panel state
Flow log panel UI component with list/detail views

verification_questions.question: Does the bug fix correctly handle legacy tenants (no tenant_instances records) by falling back to the original active flow query?
Is the fire-and-forget execution logging truly non-blocking and does it handle failures gracefully without affecting message processing?
Does the JSONB append operation (node_trace || @append::jsonb) correctly accumulate trace entries across multiple messages in the same session?
Are the new API endpoints properly authenticated and do they validate tenant ownership before returning execution logs?
Does the FlowLogPanel correctly implement mutual exclusion with AiChatPanel and SimulationPanel?

intentional_exclusions: No ghost path visualization on canvas

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Fire-and-forget logging catches all exceptions and logs warnings. Failed logging does not affect message processing. API endpoints return proper error codes.
